inventory.text:
name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main]

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
        with:
          version: 11
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      # Gate at critical: the remaining high advisories are all Next 15-only
      # and cannot be fixed inside 14.2.x. Raise to `high` after the Next 15 upgrade.
      - run: pnpm audit --prod --audit-level critical
      - run: pnpm exec tsc --noEmit
      - run: pnpm lint
      - run: pnpm build

decisions: - `next.config.mjs` has `images`: review image defaults (TTL 14400s, sizes omit 16, qualities [75], at most 3 redirects and blocked local IPs) and localPatterns.search; preserve image security.
- `package.json` scripts.build invokes next build; `next.config.mjs` has `eslint`: next lint is removed and next build no longer lints; use an explicit ESLint command and CI lint gate.
- Also review the [Next 16 upgrade guide](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/upgrading/version-16) for metadata promises, browser support and target-minor changes.
